*** FINDING: RI-CAM02 SE's AUTO-RECENTRE ARMS CORRECTLY AND HAS NOTHING TO DO. Built the sprint control properly (swing the view 100 deg off the heading with look input, then hold sprint forward with no look). Measured: recentre_active TRUE for 290 consecutive frames, camera yaw moved 0.000 deg over all of them. Cause: autoRecentre() closes CAMERA yaw onto PLAYER yaw, and locomotion is camera-relative -- so a look swing turns the BODY too, at up to 720 deg/s, closing a 100 deg error in ~9 frames, while SE's own gate needs 20 clear frames of committed sprinting before it will act.
